name: Can I request specific electrical brands or systems during the coordination process?

mainEntity.name: Can I request specific electrical brands or systems during the coordination process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can request specific electrical brands or systems, and this input is crucial during the early stages of coordination. Informing City Dweller, LLC of your preferences allows us to integrate those specific requirements into the design and procurement phases. Our coordination process will then ensure that the chosen systems are compatible with other building components, meet all regulatory standards, and are properly installed by the electrical sub-trade. Early communication of these preferences helps avoid delays and ensures your vision is realized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can request specific electrical brands or systems early in the coordination process, and City Dweller, LLC will integrate them into the project plan.
